description: Header file defining an abstract class `em_metrics_t` for managing metrics and related messaging in a Wi-Fi mesh environment. Contains pure virtual functions for data model access, state management, and manager retrieval, along with various methods for handling link metrics, beacon metrics, and communication with stations.

classes.name: em_metrics_t
classes.description: Abstract base class for managing and processing Wi-Fi mesh metrics, messages, and communication with stations. Implements methods for creating and handling various metrics TLVs, message processing, and state management.
